q.why: Why is the inverter doing this?

why.candidate: candidate: its condition isn't met, so it isn't executed
why.execution_off: Off: the schedule is shown but not applied
why.no_runtime: No executor record for this slot
why.explain: The schedule is Helman's plan, the last command is what Helman wrote to the inverter, and the configuration is what the inverter's mode registers read now. Matching registers are a configuration check, not proof of what the inverter physically does.
why.registers: Mode registers of the last command
why.evidence_note: A difference shows what the registers read; it does not by itself tell why (a write that failed, a change made on the inverter, or a register read late).

agreement.mismatch_observed: Doesn't match the last command; the registers hold {mode}
agreement.unavailable: Unknown: some mode registers can't be read
agreement.not_bound: Unknown: not every mode register of the profile is found
agreement.no_profile: Not readable for a Custom inverter

next.explain: Planned actions from the schedule; a candidate runs only once its condition is met.
next.optimizer_note: The schedule does not record why an optimizer chose this action.

limits.none: No limits are readable for this inverter.
limits.scope_helman: Helman config, written after each mode
limits.scope_config: Helman config: discharge floor to charge ceiling
limits.explain: Settings as the inverter and Helman's config report them now; they are limits, not measured flows.
limits.evidence_note: Inverter settings only; the battery's own BMS limits are not part of this answer.

operating.derived_note: The inverter derives its AC figures rather than measuring them separately, so conversion loss isn't visible here.
operating.temperature_summary: Today {min} to {max}, mean {mean}; warmest around {max_at}. {coverage} of the day so far is recorded.
operating.history_failed: Today's history could not be loaded.
operating.extrema_statistics: Five-minute averages; minimum and maximum are the recorder's five-minute statistics.
operating.extrema_recorded: Five-minute averages of recorded states; minimum and maximum are the raw recorded values.
operating.no_phases: No per-phase readings for this inverter.

trust.explain: How the integration's link to the inverter reports itself. This is the data available, not a full health check of the inverter.

status.unavailable: No grid power reading right now.

q.phases: How is each phase using the grid?
q.money: What has the grid cost or earned today?
q.outage: What happens when the grid is unavailable?

voltage.no_profile: Needs a hardware profile with phase readings.
voltage.no_profile_long: Per-phase voltage needs a hardware profile on the inverter; this one is Custom, so there is nothing per phase to show.
voltage.no_sensors: The hardware profile's phase voltage sensors are not found or are disabled.
voltage.unavailable_now: Phase voltages are unavailable right now.
voltage.none_today: No phase voltage is recorded today yet.
voltage.spread: Largest difference between phases at one time
voltage.spread_none: Not enough simultaneous readings to compare phases.
voltage.explain: Today so far, in 5-minute steps, at the inverter's terminals. The shaded 207–253 V band and the 230 V line are references for orientation, not a compliance verdict or the inverter's protection setting.
voltage.source_statistics: Read from 5-minute statistics: each step's min and max are that step's own extremes.
voltage.source_history: Read from recorded states: min and max are recorded values, each held until the next.
voltage.weighting: The average weights each reading by how long it held, and a stretch without readings is a gap, never a zero. The difference between phases compares their 5-minute averages only where every compared phase has a reading.
voltage.location_note: These are the inverter's terminal voltages, not readings at the meter or the distribution grid's connection point; they can differ from the voltage there.
voltage.references_note: 230 V is the nominal low-voltage supply; 207–253 V is 230 V ±10 %. Supply standards such as EN 50160 judge 10-minute averages over a week, and the inverter's own over-voltage trip setting is not read here, so this chart cannot say whether either was met.

phases.no_profile: Needs a hardware profile with phase readings.
phases.no_profile_long: Per-phase power needs a hardware profile on the inverter; this one is Custom, so there is nothing per phase to show.
phases.unavailable: Phase readings are unavailable right now.
phases.explain: Power per phase at the grid meter. The current is estimated from power and voltage; it is not a measured current or breaker headroom.
phases.sign_note: Power is shown with import positive.
phases.calculation: Estimated current = |phase power| ÷ phase voltage, assuming a power factor of 1. Reactive power or a lower power factor make the real current higher.
phases.limitations: Power is the grid meter's, voltage the inverter's terminals'. The limit is the inverter's main-breaker setting, not the breaker's rating, so the comparison does not measure breaker headroom; phase sums or export power say nothing about it either.
phases.scale_limit: A full bar is the {limit} main breaker setting at {voltage}, as a picture of scale, not breaker headroom.
phases.scale_power: A full bar is {power}: no main breaker setting is readable.

money.failed: Today's money could not be loaded.
money.unpriced: No price recorded for today's grid flow.
money.unpriced_long: No import or export rate is recorded for today's grid flow, so nothing can be valued.
money.explain: Paid to and received from the grid: the import and export meters at each hour's rate. Energy without a rate is left out, not counted as zero, and fixed fees are not included.
money.valuation: The chart prices each slot from the price rails, while the totals above price each hour from recorded statistics, so the two can differ slightly.

next.explain: Planned figures are Helman's grid forecast, an estimate rather than a commitment.
next.explain_adjusted: Planned figures are Helman's grid forecast with the schedule applied, an estimate rather than a commitment.
next.evidence_note: Planned and measured grid flow with the price rails and the schedule; pick tomorrow in the day bar.

outage.explain: The state is the inverter's own run mode. Runtimes are its lifetime counters. Whether the backup output supplies the house during an outage depends on wiring and backup settings not read here.
outage.no_readings: No frequency or run mode reading is available.
outage.evidence_note: Readings as the inverter reports them now.

tile.no_voltage_sensors: The phase voltage sensors are not found.

status.unavailable: No battery power reading right now.

flow.net: Net change today: {kwh}, by the battery's own meters.
flow.unknown_charge: {kwh} of today's charge has no known source.

exception.bms_disconnected: The inverter reports the battery management system as disconnected ({state}).
exception.off_grid: The inverter reports off-grid operation ({state}): the battery and solar supply the house.

q.reserve: How much energy can I still use or store?
q.next: What will the battery do next?
q.charge: Where did today's charge come from, and what did it cost?
q.diagnostics: What can the battery diagnostics tell me?

reserve.unavailable: The charge or remaining energy is unavailable.
reserve.unavailable_long: The battery's charge (SoC) or remaining energy has no valid reading right now, so the reserve cannot be worked out.
reserve.no_range: No configured SoC range to measure against.
reserve.range_scope: the battery's configured min and max SoC
reserve.explain: Usable energy is what is stored above the floor Helman plans with; room is what still fits below the ceiling. The time estimate assumes the recent power continues; the plan can change it.
reserve.capacity_note: Capacity is the remaining energy divided by the SoC, as Helman's forecast works it out; the floor and ceiling are that capacity's min and max SoC shares.
reserve.chargeable_note: The inverter's own figure for energy to 100 % SoC. It is not the room below the configured ceiling, which can be lower.
reserve.time_note: The time estimate is Helman's time-to-full or time-to-empty sensor: energy to the ceiling or floor divided by the average non-idle battery power over the last {minutes} min.

next.no_change: No change planned today or tomorrow
next.plan_failed: the plan could not be loaded
next.explain: Planned charge is Helman's forecast with the schedule applied, an estimate rather than a commitment. A candidate whose condition is not met is not executed; without an action the inverter returns to normal operation.

limits.idle: idle: no ceiling is in play
limits.at_ceiling_charge: charging at {power}, at the lowest known ceiling ({source}, {ceiling}): consistent with it limiting, not proof that it does
limits.at_ceiling_discharge: discharging at {power}, at the lowest known ceiling ({source}, {ceiling}): consistent with it limiting, not proof that it does
limits.below_charge: charging at {power}, below every known ceiling: the actual limiting cause is not known
limits.below_discharge: discharging at {power}, below every known ceiling: the actual limiting cause is not known
limits.cold: The battery reads {temperature}. Cold batteries can be allowed less power; this reading alone does not show that is happening.
limits.explain: The BMS ceiling is what the battery management system allows now; the inverter setting and Helman's planning limit are configuration. Lower power than a ceiling does not show a cap is binding: the demand or target behind the power is not known here.
limits.explain_custom: Only Helman's planning limits are known: BMS ceilings need a hardware profile on the inverter, and this one is Custom. Lower power than a limit does not show it is binding.
limits.max_charge_rate_note: The inverter integration computes the max charge rate as the BMS charge current × voltage, and falls back to the inverter's charge current setting when the BMS current is not read, so it is not by itself a BMS limit.
limits.calculation: BMS ceiling = the BMS current limit × the battery voltage now; the inverter setting converts at the same voltage, so the two compare. Helman's planning limit is the battery's forecast config.

charge.failed: Today's charge could not be loaded.
charge.unavailable: Today's charge origin needs the house meter the device reports read; it is not configured.
charge.unavailable_no_house_node: Today's charge origin needs the house in the device tree, which has no house node yet.
charge.unavailable_not_loaded: Today's charge origin is not available yet: Helman is still loading. Try again shortly.
charge.none_long: The battery has not charged today, so there is nothing to split or price.
charge.explain: What charged the battery today, estimated hour by hour from the metered flows; energy no meter explains stays unknown. It is today's charge, not what is stored in the battery now, which also holds earlier days' charge. The paid cost prices only grid charge with a known rate.
charge.attribution_note: Rates are weighted by the energy charged at each hour's rate. Forgone export value is what the solar charge would have earned exported; it was not paid.
charge.flow_ratio_note: A flow ratio over today, not round-trip efficiency: the battery started and stands at different charge levels.

diagnostics.cycles_invalid_counters: the lifetime counters have no valid reading
diagnostics.cycles_no_capacity: the capacity cannot be worked out
diagnostics.cycles_note: Equivalent full cycles = (lifetime energy in + out) ÷ (2 × {capacity}, today's nominal capacity). The counters run since they were last reset, so this is usage, not state of health or remaining life.
diagnostics.cycles_note_no_capacity: Equivalent full cycles need both lifetime energy counters and the capacity; they measure usage, not state of health or remaining life.
diagnostics.explain: Readings as the hardware reports them; none of them is a health verdict, and the hardware's state-of-health reading is not used.
diagnostics.evidence_note: Readings the hardware's integration disables by default appear here once they are enabled.

solar.load_failed: Solar details could not be loaded.
solar.history_failed: Today's history could not be loaded.
solar.forecast_unavailable: No solar forecast is available yet.

status.unavailable: No solar power reading right now.

next.tomorrow: No more production forecast today; tomorrow {kwh}

exception.off_grid: The inverter reports off-grid operation ({state}): solar can only supply the house and the battery.

q.destinations: Where has today's solar energy gone?
q.strings: How are the solar strings contributing?
q.outlook: What can I expect beyond today?

production.no_comparison: Nothing recorded to compare yet today
production.no_comparison_long: No elapsed slot of today has both a recorded production and a forecast yet, so there is nothing to compare.
production.zero_forecast: no production was forecast: no percentage
production.now_no_forecast: {power}; this slot's forecast is zero, so no percentage
production.projection_scope: today's meter so far plus the remaining forecast
production.peak_unit: the power sensor's unit is not a power unit
production.explain: Recorded production and the forecast are compared over the same elapsed 15-minute slots; the slot in progress and slots without a recording are left out of both. The estimate for today assumes the rest of the forecast comes true.
production.bias_not_applied: not applied: the forecast is uncorrected
production.evidence_note: The bias correction scales the forecaster's own figures by what past days actually produced. The chart below adds the uncorrected forecast and the correction diagnostics.

destinations.failed: Where today's solar went could not be worked out right now.
destinations.unavailable_no_house_node: Needs a house node with a power sensor: the split is worked out from the house's energy.
destinations.unavailable_no_house_meter: Needs a house energy meter: the split is worked out from the house's energy.
destinations.unavailable_no_solar_meter: Needs a solar energy meter: the device reports have no solar energy to split.
destinations.unavailable_not_loaded: Helman is still starting; try again in a moment.
destinations.none_long: The solar meter has recorded no production today.
destinations.export_scope: estimate: the rest, up to the measured export
destinations.explain: Estimates from hourly meter totals. The house share is solar used directly; solar stored in the battery counts once, as battery charge. Export is what is left, only up to the export the grid meter measured; what does not fit any of them stays not resolved rather than being forced into one.
destinations.attributed: Hours with a full source split
destinations.incomplete: Today's statistics are not complete yet; the hour in progress counts only what is recorded so far.
destinations.reconcile_note: The split is read from hourly statistics, which lag the live meters by a few minutes.
destinations.dc_split: Where the PV input goes now
destinations.dc_mixed: not known: the grid may be charging it too
destinations.dc_unavailable: No solar power reading right now.
destinations.forgone: Export value of today's solar charge
destinations.solar_unpriced: Solar charge without an export rate
destinations.value_note: Solar costs nothing to use. Income from exported solar is part of the grid's money answer; this value only says what charging the battery forwent, at the export rate.

limits.above_rating: The PV input is above the inverter's AC rating. A hybrid inverter can take more DC than it outputs as AC, for example while the battery charges; this alone does not measure lost solar.
limits.export_zero: An export limit of 0 stops export. It does not by itself curtail solar while the house or the battery can take it.
limits.explain: These are settings and the plan's intent, not measured curtailment. The power the panels could have delivered is not observed, so lost production cannot be worked out from them.
limits.explain_custom: Only Helman's own export cap and plan are known: the inverter's caps and rating need a hardware profile, and this inverter is Custom. Settings are not measured curtailment.
limits.no_settings: No settings are readable for this inverter.
limits.evidence_note: Readings as the inverter and Helman report them now.

strings.common_value: {coverage} of today, when every string was recorded
strings.no_common: No period yet in which every string was recorded.
strings.chart_summary: Each string's power over today, in 5-minute means.
strings.explain: Strings can differ in panel count, orientation and shading, which are not known here, so a difference between them is not a fault.
strings.calculation: Energy is each string's 5-minute mean power × the time it was recorded; a gap stays missing. Shares compare only the time every string was recorded.
strings.no_normalization: Not normalised by installed capacity or orientation per string: these are not known.

outlook.explain: The bias-corrected forecast, by calendar day in Home Assistant's time zone.
outlook.explain_raw: The forecast without bias correction, by calendar day in Home Assistant's time zone.
outlook.capacity_scope: the solar node's max power in Helman config, not a measurement
outlook.per_kwp_note: The configured max power is not necessarily the array's peak power, and when the counter started is not known: this is not an annual yield and says nothing about performance.
outlook.evidence_note: Forecast days beyond the forecaster's horizon show no forecast rather than zero.

curve.title: Production today
curve.no_sensor: Today's production curve needs a solar power sensor.
curve.unit: The solar power sensor's unit is not a power unit, so today's production is not drawn.

flow.unresolved: {kwh} of today's solar is not resolved to a destination.
flow.strings_failed: The strings' energy today could not be loaded.

house.load_failed: House details could not be loaded.
house.history_failed: The history could not be loaded.
house.forecast_unavailable: No house consumption forecast is available yet.
house.forecast_not_configured: No house consumption forecast is configured.
house.incomplete: Today's statistics are not complete yet; the figures can still move a little.

status.unavailable: No house power reading right now.

next.candidate: candidate, its condition is not met
next.rest_scope: forecast house load from now to midnight
next.no_runs: No appliance runs are planned for today or tomorrow.
next.execution_off: Schedule execution is switched off: the plan is shown, but Helman does not carry it out.
next.explain: The forecast is the house load Helman learned, with the planned appliance runs added. A candidate run is placed by an optimizer whose condition is not met; it does not run unless the condition is met.
next.forecast_note: The forecast includes the appliance runs the plan schedules; the uncertain extra use of appliances that can be shifted is not added on top.
next.plan_note: The plan says what is scheduled and by whom, not why an optimizer chose it.

exception.off_grid: The inverter reports off-grid operation ({state}): the house runs from the battery and solar.

today.failed: Today's figures could not be loaded.
today.unavailable_not_loaded: Today's figures are not available yet.

q.consumers: What used the most energy today?
q.phases: How is load distributed across phases?

sources.none: The house has used no energy today yet.
sources.independence_scope: share of the house's energy not taken from the grid
sources.self_scope: share of the solar produced that the house and the battery took
sources.self_no_matched_solar: no solar with a full source split today
sources.explain: Estimated hour by hour from the energy meters. Energy no measured source explains stays unknown and is not counted as independence. Self-consumption is divided by solar production, independence by the house's consumption.
sources.paid_scope: an estimate from attributed prices, not a bill
sources.forgone: Export value of the solar used
sources.forgone_scope: what the solar used would have earned exported: not a payment
sources.ambiguous_scope: energy whose source hourly totals cannot tell apart, assigned solar first
sources.matched_solar: Solar with a full source split
sources.solar_used: Of it used by the house and the battery
sources.solar_unmatched: Solar in hours without a source split
sources.evidence_note: The same accounting as the device reports and the solar detail.

consumers.none: No device has used energy today yet.
consumers.unmeasured_scope: house load no device meter explains, inverter loss included
consumers.explain: Each load is counted once: a device with sub-meters is its sub-meters plus its own rest. Costs are attributed estimates, not bills. The unmeasured remainder includes inverter conversion loss and is not proof of waste.
consumers.money_note: Export value is what the solar a device used would have earned exported: it is not a payment.
consumers.overallocated_scope: energy the sub-meters measured beyond their parent's meter
consumers.ranking_failed: Today's ranking could not be loaded.

pattern.no_meters: Needs a house power sensor or energy meter.
pattern.partial_today: Today has records for {compared} of {elapsed} completed hours; only those hours are compared.
pattern.no_earlier: No earlier {weekday} has records for the same hours, so there is nothing to compare yet.
pattern.no_today: Nothing recorded today yet to compare.
pattern.no_energy_meter: The comparison needs a house energy meter.
pattern.no_elapsed_hour: No hour of today is complete yet.
pattern.comparison_explain: Today's completed hours to {time} against the same hours of earlier {weekday}s; an earlier day missing any of them is left out, so a partial day is never compared with a full one.
pattern.overnight_explain: An observation, not a diagnosis: the minimum alone does not say what was running then, nor what the house's permanent load is.
pattern.overnight_no_power_sensor: The overnight minimum needs a house power sensor.
pattern.overnight_unit: The house power sensor's unit is not one this can read.
pattern.days_note: Each day over the same completed hours to {time}.
pattern.no_profile: The house forecast has not learned a profile yet.
pattern.profile_note: A learned expectation from the house forecast, per hour of the week and without shiftable appliances; not measured history.

phases.none_mapped_short: No devices mapped to a phase
phases.none_mapped: No device is mapped to a phase yet. Set a device's house phase in its editor (Groups and phase) to estimate each phase's load; unmapped devices stay unassigned.
phases.unassigned_scope: devices without a phase and the unmeasured house load
phases.unknown_loads: No reading now, so not in the totals: {names}.
phases.explain: An estimate from the devices you mapped, not a measured phase meter. A three-phase device counts a third on each phase.
phases.eps_unavailable: The inverter's EPS phase readings are unavailable.
phases.runtime_scope: Helman's estimate at the battery's recent discharge; it changes with the load
phases.assumptions: Each load is counted once: a device with sub-meters is its sub-meters plus its own rest. A device without its own phase is on its parent's only when the parent is single-phase. A three-phase device counts a third on each phase, which is an estimate, not a measured balance. Unmeasured house load cannot be placed on a phase.
phases.over_assigned_value: {power} more assigned than measured: a device is likely on another phase
phases.measured_explain: Measured by Helman from the inverter's output, the grid meter and the EPS output on each phase. Assigned is what the devices you mapped to the phase draw now, a three-phase device a third on each phase; the difference is load on that phase no assigned device explains.
phases.devices_empty: No device is mapped to this phase.
phases.formula: On-grid, a phase's house load is the inverter's output on that phase plus what the grid meter imports on it (less what it exports), plus the EPS output. Off-grid the grid is disconnected and the EPS output is the whole house load. The total is the sum of the three phases.
phases.inputs_none: Measuring the phases needs an inverter hardware profile; without one, the phases are estimated from your wiring map alone.

ev_charger.load_failed: Charger details could not be loaded.

status.unavailable: No charger power reading right now.

q.plan: When will charging happen, and will it reach the target?
q.today: What powered the charger today, and what did it cost?
q.trust: Can I trust the charger readings?

car.none: No car is configured for this charger.
car.ambiguous: {count} cars are configured and nothing names the one plugged in, so no car's charge is shown.
car.name: Car
car.selected_plan: named by the plan's slot in progress
car.needed_unknown: unknown without the charge and its limit

progress.no_session: No car is connected: no session is in progress. The counters below are what the charger last reported.
progress.segment_value: {time}: the latest start of charging, not the session's start
progress.segment_failed: When this charging began could not be read.
progress.no_profile: Session counters need a hardware profile on the charger; this one is Custom.
progress.eta_no_target: no estimate without the car's charge and limit
progress.explain: Session figures are the charger's own counters. The time to the limit assumes the power now continues, without pauses, taper or losses: it is not a ready-by time.
progress.duration_unusable: This counter does not read as a plausible session duration, so no duration or average is worked out from it.
progress.single_phase: Charging on one phase is an observation, not a fault: the car or the charger setting can choose it.
progress.calculation: Energy still needed = (limit − charge) ÷ 100 × the car's configured capacity. The time to the limit divides that by the charger's power now.

plan.failed: The plan could not be loaded.
plan.none: No charging planned today or tomorrow
plan.execution_off_short: Planned, but schedule execution is off
plan.execution_off: Schedule execution is off: Helman does not carry out these windows.
plan.projection_failed: The projection could not be loaded.

unsupported.no_vehicle: Which car charges is not known, so no completion is estimated.
unsupported.no_target: The car's charge, charge limit or capacity is not known, so no completion is estimated.
unsupported.reached: The car is already at or above its charge limit.
unsupported.no_plan: Without the plan no completion is estimated.
unsupported.execution_off: Schedule execution is off, so the plan does not establish a completion.
unsupported.candidates_only: This car's windows are candidates whose condition is not met: they do not establish a completion.
unsupported.candidate_first: A candidate window comes before this car's planned ones, and the projection fills the car through it: it cannot tell what the planned windows alone would deliver.
unsupported.no_windows: No window charges this car, so no completion is estimated.
unsupported.stale: The projection was computed for an earlier slot or another plan, so it is not used.
unsupported.no_projection: The plan's projection has no energy for this car's windows.

plan.end_soc: Charge at the end of the plan
plan.estimate_scope: an estimate under the current plan, not a guarantee
plan.explain: The projection is Helman's planned energy for each window, added to the car's charge now. Only windows that will run count. It is not a guarantee: the car, the weather and the plan can change it.
plan.evidence_note: A candidate window was placed by an optimizer whose condition is not met; it is not executed. The plan does not say why an optimizer chose a window, and no reason is inferred here.

waiting.fault: The charger reports a fault: {fault}. Other explanations are not considered while it does.
waiting.no_car: The charger reports no car connected ({state}).
waiting.unknown: The cause cannot be determined from what the charger and the plan report.
waiting.several: Several observations apply; the actual cause cannot be singled out:
waiting.reached: {name} is at or above its charge limit ({soc} of {limit}).
waiting.execution_off: Schedule execution is off: Helman does not start charging.
waiting.next_window: Not planned to charge now; next window {window}.
waiting.no_window: Not planned to charge today or tomorrow.
waiting.candidate: The window in progress is a candidate whose condition is not met: it is not executed.
waiting.runtime_failed: Helman's command for this slot failed: {message}.
waiting.eco: ECO mode charges from surplus. The charger starts from {start}; its grid reading is {grid}. This is context, not proof that surplus is why it waits.
waiting.no_status: The charger's status is not one this view interprets.
waiting.no_profile: A Custom charger reports no status, so a car may or may not be connected.
waiting.evidence_note: Readings as reported. A cause is named only where the charger or the plan reports it.

today.failed: Today's figures could not be loaded.
today.unavailable_no_charger_node: Today's report has no figures for this charger.
today.unavailable_not_loaded: Today's figures are not available yet.
today.paid_scope: estimated: attributed grid cost, not a bill
today.not_session: These are today's figures since midnight, not the charging session's.
today.forgone_scope: solar it used that could have been sold
today.estimated: This charger has no meter of its own: its energy is an estimated share of its parent's.
today.attribution_note: Each hour's charger energy is split by the house's source mix in that hour and priced at that hour's price: an estimate, not a measurement.

incomparable.missing: Not compared: a power or phase reading, or its time, is missing.
incomparable.not_together: Not compared: the readings were not taken at the same time.

trust.explain: Only faults and network states the charger reports are shown as such. A difference between readings is evidence, not a fault, and a link success rate below 100 % alone says nothing about the connection now.
trust.evidence_note: Readings as reported by the charger, each with its own update time.

helpers.card_size: Number of grid rows this card reports to the dashboard layout
helpers.max_power: Caps the power-flow arrow scale; leave empty to auto-scale
helpers.collapsed_consumers_count: Number of house consumers shown before "Show more"; defaults to 3

reason.stale_forecast: has not refreshed for over an hour — the background refresh may be broken
reason.house_profile_insufficient_history: does not have enough recorder history yet to fit a consumption profile
reason.house_profile_entity_missing: cannot be refitted — the configured house energy entity no longer exists
reason.house_profile_training_failed: could not be retrained — check the Home Assistant log

device_energy.scheduler_note: The device scheduler projects with this figure

device_reports.error: The report could not be loaded: {message}

unavailable.no_house_node: Device reports need the house power sensor (Energy nodes → House → Power). Without it there is no house device tree to report on.
unavailable.no_house_meter: Device reports need the house energy meter (Energy nodes → House → Forecast → Total energy). Without it the house total and every remainder are unknown.

device_reports.missing_meters: Not configured: {meters}. The source colours cannot show what these meters would have measured.

quality.ambiguous: {kwh} kWh ({pct} % of the house) assigned by the solar-first rule
quality.unattributed: {kwh} kWh ({pct} % of the house) not explained by any measured source
quality.mismatch: {kwh} kWh ({pct} % of the house) of measured flows exceeding the house meter

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.overallocated: children measure {kwh} kWh more than this meter

over_time.title: Over time
over_time.partial_note: Dimmed columns are partial: the period cuts them, or they are still running.
over_time.overallocated: devices measure {kwh} kWh more than the house meter

daily_profile.title: Daily profile
daily_profile.per_day: Per day, over the hours with data
daily_profile.price_note: Shaded from the cheapest to the dearest hour; a negative price has its own colour.
daily_profile.note: Mean power per hour of day, over the hours each row has data for. Each row is shaded relative to its own peak; hatched cells have no data.
